fields.System.Title: INB-305 — Suggest using capacity and zone rules
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a putaway operator, I want suggestions that account for space, weight, and zone
suitability, so that I stop being sent to locations where the pallet will not fit.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a task, then the suggestion respects remaining weight and volume capacity, not
  • just occupancy.
  • - Given the product, then temperature class, hazmat class, and stackability are
  • respected.
  • - Given mixing rules, then locations that do not allow a second product or batch are
  • excluded.
  • - Given several valid candidates, then the nearest to the receiving location is
  • preferred.
  • - Given the override data from [INB-304](INB-304-override-suggested-location.md), then
  • the rule is tuned against it and the override rate is measured before and after.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, masterdata, inventory |
| Tables | putaway_task, location, stock_balance |
| Risks | Null capacity ([doc 03 §7.4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); suggestion filled by someone else ([doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
